latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of fix-lifecycle-stages skill.
- Audits and backfills missing lifecycle stage data for contacts and companies.
- Fixes records stuck at disallowed or backwards stages using correct HubSpot progression logic.
- Provides API scripts and manual list-based methods for context-aware stage assignment.
- Includes guidance for creating prevention workflows to stop future lifecycle stage gaps.
